# awscc_comprehend_document_classifier_endpoint (Resource)

An Amazon Comprehend endpoint that hosts a custom document classification model for real-time inference.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `desired_inference_units` (Number) The desired number of inference units to be used by the model. Each inference unit represents throughput of 100 characters per second.
- `endpoint_name` (String) The name of the endpoint. The name must be unique within the AWS Region and account.
- `model_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the document classifier model to which the endpoint is attached.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the endpoint being created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the document classifier endpoint.
- `creation_time` (String) The creation date and time of the endpoint.
- `current_inference_units` (Number) The number of inference units currently used by the model using this endpoint.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The date and time that the endpoint was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The initial part of a key-value pair that forms a tag associated with a given resource.
- `value` (String) The second part of a key-value pair that forms a tag associated with a given resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_comprehend_document_classifier_endpoint.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the document classifier endpoint

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_comprehend_document_classifier_endpoint.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_comprehend_document_classifier_endpoint.example "arn"
```
